title: Musical Question · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Musical Question · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a short familiar two-part tune known to both players. The lead hums the first part and the partner hums the next part. The partner continues with the agreed second part. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Musical Question, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The partner continues with the agreed second part.
recall.why: The partner continues with the agreed second part.
